Scope addition (2026-11-26T10:35Z) from the seat's L1 ACCEPT on PR #37474 (7189551234, item 5). #37455 moved the AI assistant and the right-slot toggle to the end of each page's title row. Pages with no title row in a package scope (loading, not-found) therefore draw no assistant control; ⌘. still toggles the slot there. This is invisible while the top bar exists. When this card removes the bar, those pages must get a panel control, so the assistant is never unreachable. Acceptance gains one case: a page with no title row still offers the panel control.

Also read follow-up card #37520 (pins and the `divider` hairline left from #37474) before cutting this card's surface. Whichever of the two lands second rebases.
